title: The Eleventh of a Set of Ten
subtitle: 古代文明 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 古代文明（历史社会与文化·古代文明）
meta: 主题语境：古代文明（历史社会与文化·古代文明）　|　核心词汇：volume　|　正文 333 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 volume 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① volume they found in 1961 was the eleventh of a set everybody had thought contained ten, and it changed nothing and it changed everything, and my grandmother, who was not a scholar, was the one who noticed; no volume in that case had ever been read. She said the ② volume of it was wrong: eleven centimetres taller than the other ten, and the box had been made for ten.

The ③ volume of correspondence about it, between the museum and the county, runs to four hundred pages and says almost nothing; I have read it and I do not recommend it. In the reading room the radio was always on, and at eleven the ④ volume went up for the news, and my grandmother asked twice for it to be turned down, and it never was.

She was given ⑤ a volume of photographs of the pit, eleven years of digging in eleven pages, and she said the ⑥ volume of earth they had moved — forty thousand tonnes — was the only number anybody ever remembered and the only one that meant nothing at all.

In 1972 she left a note in the file saying '⑦ turn down the volume', and nobody knows whether she meant the radio or the correspondence. The ⑧ volume of work involved in cataloguing the set was eleven years for three people, and the catalogue came out in 1979 with eleven errors in it, every one of them in the eleventh ⑨ volume, which she had not been allowed to see.

The ⑩ volume of the eleventh — the space it takes on the shelf — is eleven centimetres more than the others, and the box was made again in 1989 and is still too small, and the volume has never been opened since. She died in 1998. I have never read a word of any of them, and I have stood in front of the case on the left for eleven minutes at a time, and I have decided that is enough.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 卷；册；本（成套书的一册）
B. n. 体积；容积；（占用的）空间
E. 固定搭配：a volume of ... 一卷／一册……
F. 固定搭配：the volume of ... ……的量；……的体积
G. 固定搭配：turn up / down the volume 调高／调低音量
H. 固定搭配：volume of work 工作量；工作总量

items.q: the volume of it was wrong
The volume of correspondence about it
at eleven the volume went up
a volume of photographs of the pit
the volume of earth they had moved
The volume of work involved in cataloguing
every one of them in the eleventh volume

answers.why: the volume 意为“（一套书中的）一册、一卷”，1961 年发现的那一册是大家以为只有十册的一套书里的第十一册。
the volume of it 意为“它的体积、尺寸”，她说它的尺寸不对，比其余十册高十一厘米。
the volume of correspondence 意为“往来信件的量、总量”，博物馆与郡之间关于此事的通信多达四百页。
the volume 意为“音量”，阅览室的收音机一直开着，十一点播新闻时音量会调高。
a volume of ... 意为“一册／一卷……”，她得到的是一册关于那个坑的照片集。
the volume of earth 意为“土的方量、体积”，他们挖走的土方有四万吨。
turn down the volume 意为“把音量调低”，1972 年她在卷宗里留了张条子写着“把音量调低”。
volume of work 意为“工作量、工作总量”，把这套书编目用了三个人十一年。
the eleventh volume 意为“第十一册”，1979 年出版的目录里有十一处错误，全在第十一册里。
the volume of the eleventh 意为“第十一册的体积、它占的空间”，它比其余的宽出十一厘米。
